top_signals.title: Treasury yields are lower after reaching multiyear highs, traders weigh latest bond auction
top_signals.summary: Traders digested comments from a top Federal Reserve official while awaiting another long-dated bond auction.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Gen Zers are now the biggest spenders in the art market, survey finds
top_signals.summary: Gen Zers have become the most active buyers of high-end art, changing the face of a market long dominated by Baby Boomers, according to a new survey.
